:::{#exm-deriv-linear-map}
#### Derivative of a linear map

Let $\matr{A} = \begin{pmatrix} 2 & 3 \end{pmatrix}$ ($1 \times 2$) and $\vb = \tp{(\beta_1, \beta_2)}$.
Then $\matr{A}\vb = 2\beta_1 + 3\beta_2$, and by @thm-deriv-linear-map:

$$
\underbrace{\deriv{\vb}(\matr{A}\vb)}_{2 \times 1}
= \underbrace{\tp{\matr{A}}}_{2 \times 1}
= \begin{pmatrix} 2 \\
3 \end{pmatrix}
$$

:::
